cd /tmp; cat > /tmp/an.py <<'EOF'
import re,sys,collections
rd=re.compile(r'^\d+\s+(read|pread64)\((\d+)<([^>]*)>.*?\)\s+=\s+(\d+)$')
rows=collections.defaultdict(list); order=[]
for l in open(sys.argv[1],errors='replace'):
    m=rd.match(l)
    if m and 'binlog' in m.group(3): 
        p=m.group(3); 
        if p not in rows: order.append(p)
        rows[p].append(int(m.group(4)))
tot=0;n=0;big=0;bn=0
hist=collections.Counter()
for p,v in rows.items():
    tot+=sum(v);n+=len(v)
    for x in v: hist[x if x<=64 else (4096 if x<=4096 else (65536 if x<=65536 else 10**7))]+=1
print(len(rows),'files',n,'reads',tot,'bytes')
print(sorted(hist.items())[:20])
# per-file
for p in order[:6]:
    v=rows[p];print(p,len(v),sum(v),collections.Counter(v).most_common(5))
import json
json.dump({p:len(v) for p,v in rows.items()},open('/tmp/files.json','w'))
EOF
